description: This file defines the internal class 'ProxyGenerator' responsible for generating proxy classes (RPC stubs called invokers) within the Orleans code generation framework. It includes methods for creating class declarations, proxy methods, constructors, and related code constructs, heavily utilizing the Roslyn syntax APIs.

classes.name: ProxyGenerator
classes.description: Internal class responsible for generating proxy implementation classes in Orleans RPC infrastructure.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates the proxy class declaration and associated metadata based on interface description.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Returns the sanitized class name for the proxy based on the interface description.

methods.name: GetFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Obtains descriptions of fields, primarily copiers, needed for proxy class.

methods.name: GetFieldDeclarations
methods.description: Creates syntax nodes for the class's private readonly fields based on descriptions.

methods.name: CreateProxyMethods
methods.description: Creates proxy method implementations for each interface method.

methods.name: CreateAsyncProxyMethodBody
methods.description: Builds the method body for asynchronous proxy methods, including request creation and invocation.

methods.name: GenerateConstructors
methods.description: Generates constructors for the proxy class, potentially chaining to base class constructors.

methods.name: GetParameterSyntax
methods.description: Creates parameter syntax nodes for proxy methods, handling ref/out/in modifier and types.
